head: codex/202-authorized-learner-transport-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b1.5] Extend authenticated Raft transport to governed learners
body:
Closes #202

## Summary

- add a learner-owned production authority and factory with distinct durable transport identity and live boot custody
- enforce pending-exclusion recovery identity, committed-index, target-membership, deadline, route-drain, and cache-first exact-retry semantics
- prove a real fourth OpenRaft node over authenticated Quinn through add_learner, snapshot catch-up, later append, fencing, and clean shutdown
- retain immutable merge-safe v7 proof with no machine-local cleanliness exceptions

## Validation

- 42/42 private runner tests covering 36 semantic cases
- 13/13 public boundary tests
- 31 exact named behavior assertions
- distributed_transport, distributed_discovery, and distributed_runtime_transport compile checks
- strict library and public-target Clippy
- immutable v7 receipt validator PASS
- fresh independent exact-head review PASS at 4b55f2e4a40ce03e1612aaf4da7c129962f3369e

## Boundary

This PR implements #202 only. Joint/final voter membership remains #199, and final production integration remains #142.
